coverage: Shared North American boundary config/north_america_bounds.json (lon -180..-15, lat 5..85, 3300x1600). Full rectangle; missing stays transparent, never 0%.
fallback_note: RRFS TCDC entire-atmosphere analysis (%) where no valid GOES mask exists. GDPS TotalCloudCover only for verified remaining gaps.
fallback_rrfs: NOAA RRFS TCDC entire atmosphere (considered as a single layer), analysis step, %
freshness_label: LIVE / CURRENT OBSERVATION + MODEL FILL (GOES FD 10-min + RRFS/GDPS fallback)
precedence: 1) Valid GOES-East/GOES-West full-disk BCM (DQF==0). 2) RRFS TCDC where GOES invalid/missing. 3) GDPS TotalCloudCover only for verified remaining gaps. Missing satellite pixels are NEVER rendered as clear sky.
sat_note: Full-disk (ABI-L2-ACMF) verified live on both sats; CONUS (ACMC) not assumed to cover Canada. Highest Arctic latitudes: geostationary quality degrades — documented gap, model fill only.

satellites.goes_east: GOES-19, ABI L2 Clear Sky Mask full-disk (ABI-L2-ACMF), BCM+DQF, ~10-min FD scans, s3://noaa-goes19/
satellites.goes_west: GOES-18, ABI L2 Clear Sky Mask full-disk (ABI-L2-ACMF), BCM+DQF, ~10-min FD scans, s3://noaa-goes18/

source_name: NOAA GOES-East (GOES-19) + GOES-West (GOES-18) ABI L2 Clear Sky Mask full-disk observations, RRFS TCDC fallback, GDPS fallback
title: LIVE CLOUD COVER
variable: BCM binary mask (0=clear_or_probably_clear, 1=cloudy_or_probably_cloudy) gated DQF==0 -> % per canvas neighborhood; model TCDC % in fallback domain
